// why: Type checking for CI, which `bun test` does not do — bun strips types and runs.
That matters most for `src/errors.ts`: `fail(c, code, detail)` types the detail per
code so a missing or misspelt field is a build error, and without a checker in the
pipeline that guarantee only holds on whichever machine last ran tsc.
Tests are excluded because they carry pre-existing errors — `.then` on Hono's
`Response | Promise<Response>`, narrowed union fields in the parser fixtures — that are
noise in the test bodies rather than bugs in what ships. Narrowing this to the code that
runs in production is worth more than nothing, and unexcluding them is its own change.
